name: rigol-ds1102e
description: Wait-aware USB acquisition, analysis, and evidence-bounded interpretation for the RIGOL DS1102E.

interface.shortDescription: Wait, acquire, analyze, and interpret CH1 waveforms.
interface.longDescription: Controls a USB-connected RIGOL DS1102E, waits through missing or intermittent probe contact, retains qualified captures, verifies artifacts, analyzes pulse waveforms, and produces evidence-bounded reports.
interface.defaultPrompt: Wait for stable probe contact, capture ten qualified CH1 waveforms, analyze them, and explain the evidence.
